Taurean Prince is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

Taurean Prince weighs 218 lbs (98 kg).

Taurean Prince is not in the Hall of Fame.

Power Forward and Small Forward.

Taurean Prince has made at least $53,201,959 playing professional basketball.

Taurean Prince made $13,000,000 in 2022.

Taurean Prince has won 0 championships.
